name: Acupuncturist
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom
or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Medicine skill, and the Acupuncture Lore skill. You gain the [Battle Medicine](/feat/battle-medicine-player-core) skill feat.

name: Bachuan Revolutionary
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom
or Strength, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill, and the Law Lore skill. You gain the [Sign Language](/feat/sign-language-player-core) skill feat.

name: Banished Celestial
descr:
You gain two free attribute boosts. You choose one, and the GM chooses the other based on your past life.

You’re trained in any one skill of your choice and any one Lore skill of your choice. You gain the Enlightenment in Adversity ability.

name: Eagle Hunter
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength
or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Nature skill, and the Hunting Lore skill. You gain the [Pet](/feat/pet-player-core) general feat and the [Train Animal](/feat/train-animal-player-core) skill feat, but you can use these feats only to gain and train eagles. Your trained eagles can perform the [Aid](/action/aid-player-core) action when you attempt a Nature, [Perception](/rule/perception-rules-2298), or Survival skill check. This benefit applies to only you and other characters with the eagle [hunter](/background/hunter-player-core) background.

name: Fated Rival
descr: You gain two free attribute boosts; you choose one, and the GM chooses one to complement your rival. So long as you are not in the presence of your rival, you gain the [Diehard](/feat/diehard-player-core) general feat and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against the [doomed](/condition/doomed-player-core) condition. When in the presence of your rival, you lose these benefits but gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and damage. If your rival becomes your ally or a member of your party, you gain the Diehard and save bonus benefits, as long as that’s the case.

name: Favored
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost. You’re trained in Diplomacy, Performance, or Society.

You’re trained in a Lore skill of your choice. You gain the Name Drop reaction. At the GM’s discretion, you can ask your patron for further assistance and favors, such as monetary or political support. You must keep your patron’s favor to avoid losing your benefits; what this entails is between you and the GM but usually implies never publicly speaking or acting against your patron’s wishes. If you offend your patron, you lose Name Drop until you reconcile with them.

name: Gossip
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma
or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and a Lore skill skill of your choice. You gain the [Hobnobber](/feat/hobnobber-player-core) skill feat.

name: Jeweler
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom
or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Gem Lore skill. You gain the [Crafter's Appraisal](/feat/crafter-s-appraisal-player-core-2) skill feat.

name: Kaiju Stalker
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Strength or Dexterity**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You’re trained in Athletics and gain one Athletics skill feat of your choice, best suited toward the style of hunting you prefer.

You’re trained in Kaiju Lore. When rolling a [Recall Knowledge](/action/recall-knowledge-player-core) check using Kaiju Lore and you have sight of one item that belongs to the kaiju you’re attempting to Recall Knowledge about, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the skill check. The item can range from a scale to slime, to a footprint, or to crafted or harvested goods.

name: Ocean Diver
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution
or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill, and the Ocean Lore skill. You gain the [Underwater Marauder](/feat/underwater-marauder-player-core) skill feat.

name: Professional Letter Writer
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Charisma**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in Scribing Lore. You gain one skill feat of your choice between the [Specialty Crafting](/feat/specialty-crafting-player-core) or [Multilingual](/feat/multilingual-player-core) skill feat. During your daily preparations, you can choose one additional language that you know. You can change this language the next time you make your daily preparations.

name: Remittance Agent
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution
or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill, and the Labor Lore skill or Mercenary Lore. You gain the [Experienced Professional](/feat/experienced-professional-player-core) skill feat.

name: Runaway Noble
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Charisma
or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Diplomacy skill, and the Genealogy Lore skill or Heraldry Lore. You gain the [Bon Mot](/feat/bon-mot-player-core-2) skill feat.

name: Silk Farmer
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Wisdom
or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Sericulture Lore skill. You gain the [Specialty Crafting](/feat/specialty-crafting-player-core) skill feat.

name: Streetfood Vendor
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength
or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in your choice of either the Crafting
 or the Society skill, as well as the Cooking Lore skill. You gain the [Seasoned](/feat/seasoned-player-core) skill feat.

name: Tiffin Box Deliverer
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity
or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Society skill, and the Labor Lore skill. You gain the [Streetwise](/feat/streetwise-player-core) skill feat.

name: Traveling Gourmand
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity
or Intelligence, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Survival skill, and the Cooking Lore skill. You gain the [Forager](/feat/forager-player-core) skill feat.

name: Warded by Kami
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to **Intelligence** or **Wisdom**, and one is a free attribute boost.

You’re trained in Occultism and Spirit Lore. You also gain a ward that binds you to a specific animal, plant, object, or location of your choice. Once per day, you can spend an [Interact](/action/interact-player-core) action to merge with your ward and heal Hit Points equal to your level. This action has the [healing](/trait/healing) trait.

name: Weaver
descr:
Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity
or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill, and the Basket Weaving Lore skill or Tapestry Lore or Textile Lore. You gain the [Specialty Crafting](/feat/specialty-crafting-player-core) skill feat.

name: Zodiac Bound
descr:
Fortune tellers and oracles claim that a person’s zodiac sign influences their personality and fate, and while it might not be true for all, it seems true for you. You were born under a powerful manifestation of a specific constellation, corresponding to a symbol of the zodiac. When you gain this background, choose a specific constellation from those listed below. Your associated constellation determines one of the attribute boosts you gain and an innate spell. The list includes benefits for the constellations of the Dragon Empires Zodiac, but you might have been born under a different constellation and gain different benefits as determined by the GM.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to the attribute tied to your sign, and one is a free attribute boost.

You’re trained in Astrology Lore. You also gain the ability to cast a divine innate spell, as determined by your sign. The frequency with which you can cast this spell is listed below; cantrips can be used as often as you wish. As normal, you cast non-cantrip innate spells at the lowest rank available to that spell, such as 2nd rank for [_water breathing_](/spell/water-breathing-player-core), and cantrips are heightened to half your level. Additionally, once during the prominent time for your sign (typically once per year), you can cast your sign’s spell without expending its normal use.
**The Underworld Dragon (Intelligence):** [_ignition_](/spell/ignition-player-core); at will
**The Swordswoman (Dexterity):** [_gale blast_](/spell/gale-blast-player-core-2); at will
**The Sea Dragon (Constitution):** water breathing; once per week
**The Swallow (Dexterity):** [_jump_](/spell/jump-player-core); once per day
**The Ox (Strength):** [_ant haul_](/spell/ant-haul-player-core); once per day
**The Sovereign Dragon (Charisma):** [_command_](/spell/command-player-core); once per day
**The Ogre (Strength):**[_fear_](/spell/fear-player-core); once per day
**The Forest Dragon (Wisdom):** [_tangle vine_](/spell/tangle-vine-player-core); at will
**The Blossom (Charisma):** [_dizzying colors_](/spell/dizzying-colors-player-core); once per day
**The Dog (Constitution):** [_clear mind_](/spell/clear-mind-player-core); once per week
**The Sky Dragon (Intelligence):** [_bless_](/spell/bless-player-core); once per day
**The Archer (Dexterity):** [_sure strike_](/spell/sure-strike-player-core); once per day
